subject: Privacy follow-up: data-processing intake, controller/processor alignment & security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hofstad <lena@finpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:12:00+00:00
Subject: Follow-up after demo — privacy & compliance items / DPA intake

Hi Lena,

Great to meet you today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can move compliance review forward: 

Summary from the demo / discovery
- FinPath confirmed regulated payments data and EU customers (GDPR applies).
- You indicated FinPath will act as the Controller; Redwood will be the Processing vendor for analytics/enrichment features. Please confirm if that remains accurate.
- You asked about SOC 2 and HIPAA: short answer — Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (available under NDA) and supports HIPAA workflows via Dedicated/Private deployment options and BAAs. I can share the SOC 2 summary and next steps for HIPAA if helpful.

Immediate asks from FinPath we captured
1) DPA (we will send our standard draft for your legal review).
2) Confirmation of which EU transfer clause/module you prefer for SCCs (controller -> processor flow typically uses the processor module).
3) Completion of your vendor security questionnaire — can either attach here or we can send a secure form.

Proposed next steps (timeline)
- I will send our DPA template and a link to the security questionnaire by end of day today (attached DPA template).
- Please confirm controller/processor mapping and any preferred SCC module language (we recommend processor-module language for controller->processor relationships).
- If possible, let us have redlines on the DPA within 3 business days; we’ll aim to return counters within 2 business days after receiving them.
- Ben (cc'd) will own the vendor questionnaire follow-up and schedule a 30-min compliance call with your security/engineering team.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template_v2.docx (draft)

If you prefer, I can loop in legal (Marissa) now so you have a single thread for redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Lena Hofstad <lena@finpath.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T17:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up after demo — privacy & compliance items / DPA intake

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from FinPath: 
- FinPath is the Controller for customer PII and transaction metadata. Redwood will be a Processor for the services discussed.
- For SCCs, we will need the controller-to-processor wording (we call it the "processor module"). If you have a standard clause set for that, please include it in the DPA.
- We need a copy of your SOC 2 Type II report (or an executive summary) and confirmation that you can meet our data retention/deletion requirements (we retain customer logs for up to 7 years and require deletion triggers on contract termination).

Attached is our vendor security questionnaire (FinPath_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — it's the standard intake our security team uses. If you can return it within the week that would be ideal.

DPA timeline: Legal has requested redlines within 5 business days. If you need shorter, let us know but that’s the default.

Best,
Lena Hofstad
Head of Compliance | FinPath
security@finpath.com
Attachment: FinPath_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hofstad <lena@finpath.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T18:30:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up after demo — privacy & compliance items / DPA intake

Hi Lena — looping in Redwood contracts/legal.

Thanks for the clarity that FinPath will act as Controller and Redwood as Processor. Per that mapping, our recommendation is to include the Controller->Processor SCC module (processor module) in the DPA.

Quick notes from legal and what we are attaching: 
- Attached: Redwood_DPA_draft_FinPath.docx (our standard processor-focused DPA; includes SCC module for controller->processor transfers)
- Attached: SOC2_TypeII_summary_redacted.pdf (executive summary; full report available under NDA)

Controller/Processor mapping (short)
- Data types: customer PII (names, emails), transaction metadata, derived analytics outputs.
- Processing purposes: model inference and enrichment per customer configuration; we do not use customer data for model training unless explicitly agreed and documented in the DPA.
- Retention & deletion: Redwood can support contract-triggered deletion; retention windows are configurable per deployment and enforceable in Dedicated/Private setups. Please flag any specific retention policy clauses you need in the DPA redline.

Proposed legal path and timing
1) FinPath reviews attached DPA and returns redlines (requested within 5 business days).
2) Ben will coordinate the vendor questionnaire responses — if you prefer, we can pre-fill fields and add legal/engineering comments where needed. Target: questionnaire back in 3–5 business days.
3) If there are substantial redlines on SCC language or cross-border transfer restrictions, we'll request a 30-minute review call (Marissa + Evelyn + Ben + FinPath security lead).

Ben — can you own the questionnaire follow-up and propose 2 times for a compliance call tomorrow/Thursday?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_DPA_draft_FinPath.docx; SOC2_TypeII_summary_redacted.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hofstad <lena@finpath.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T20:00:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up after demo — privacy & compliance items / DPA intake

Lena — got it, happy to own this on the Redwood side. Quick actions from me: 
- I will upload a pre-filled response to your questionnaire and send the secure link by EOD. Expect a short note in the questionnaire where we need clarifying answers from your security team.
- I’ll issue the DPA via DocuSign once we have any redlines captured — if you prefer to redline in Word, we can accept that and convert to DocuSign afterward.
- Available for a 30-min compliance call: Thu 2027-06-22 14:00-14:30 UTC or Fri 2027-06-23 09:00-09:30 UTC — let me know which works and I’ll send the invite.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
